gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at the makers' own US stores on 2026-11-08, UGREEN's ARM DH4300 Plus ($399.99) costs more than the x86 DXP2800 ($389.99), even though the ARM box can't run Plex Sonic Analysis; that the $239.99 DH2300 can't run Navidrome at all because it has no Docker; or that TerraMaster's x86 F2-425 sells for $299.99 direct.
standout_why: I compared against the cited pages: support.plex.tv Sonic Analysis says x86 is required, ARM is unsupported and analysis can take days, but it names no models and no prices. navidrome.org Overview has neither. ai.ugreen.com's Navidrome guide lists which UGREEN models run Docker and says the DH2300 doesn't, but it gives no prices and never mentions ARM or Plexamp. I also checked the top uncited results. terabytewise.com lists many prices, but they come from mixed bundle and marketplace listings dated 2026-06-29, and the page says nothing about music, Plexamp or Sonic Analysis. thisping.com would not load (certificate error). None of them puts a maker-store price next to the x86-or-ARM and Docker-or-not question that decides whether a box works for Navidrome or Plexamp.
decides: This backs the DXP2800 as the pick for Plexamp. At $389.99 it's the cheapest UGREEN box that can do both Navidrome in Docker and Sonic Analysis, and the ARM DH4300 Plus costs $10 more while being shut out of Sonic Analysis. It also rules out the DH2300 for this question: it has no Docker, so it can't run Navidrome. The TerraMaster F2-425 (x86, 4 GB, $299.99 direct) is a cheaper x86 option the page should weigh or explain away. The $296.99 Walmart DXP2800 price ChatGPT showed is $93 below UGREEN's own store, so the page should date its prices.

findings.label: Plex Sonic Analysis requirements
findings.value: Needs a Plex Pass on the server admin account and PMS 1.24.0 or newer; x86/x86-64 only ("neural network libraries ... not currently available for ARM-based processors"); can take "hours or even multiple days"
findings.source_title: Sonic Analysis for Music | Plex Support
findings.note: This page is already cited by ChatGPT. I use it here only as the test that sorts the candidates into x86 and ARM.

findings.label: Remote Watch Pass doesn't affect Plexamp
findings.value: Plex: the subscription requirements "apply only to movies/TV/video media" and "This does not affect music or photo streaming to our dedicated Plexamp and Plex Photos apps"; Remote Watch Pass $1.99/mo or $19.99/yr intro, $2.99/mo or $29.99/yr after June 1, 2026
findings.note: Plexamp members-only features named on the page: Sonic Sage, Guest DJ, Mix Builders. The Plex Pass price fields showed 'Could not load pricing'.
